parameters.text:
=You are a product analyst for the ChatGPT mobile app (goal: increase voice input usage).
From the reviews below:
1. Group into AT MOST 5 themes (name, one-line description, review_ids, count, voice_relevance: high|medium|low|none).
2. Pick the TOP 3 themes by count (ties: lower average rating first).
3. Give EXACTLY 3 quotes copied WORD FOR WORD from single reviews, under 30 words each, with review_id and theme. Do not fix spelling or combine reviews.
4. Find EXACTLY 1 recurring confusion or pain point about a fee or charge, backed by at least 3 review_ids. If none exists, set found to false and explain.
5. Add a 1-2 sentence key observation about what is going wrong or trending.
Use ONLY the reviews. Never invent quotes or numbers. Return ONLY valid JSON:
{"themes":[{"name":"","description":"","review_ids":[],"count":0,"voice_relevance":""}],
 "top_themes":["","",""],
 "quotes":[{"text":"","review_id":"","theme":""}],
 "fee_issue":{"found":true,"title":"","description":"","supporting_review_ids":[],"count":0},
 "key_observation":""}
REVIEWS:
{{ $json.reviews_block }}

=Write a Weekly Product Pulse for the ChatGPT mobile product team (goal: increase voice input usage).
Markdown. Sections:
## Top Themes (3 bullets, include review counts)
## What Users Are Saying (the 3 quotes, verbatim, in quotation marks, with theme)
## Key Observation (2-3 sentences; mention the fee issue, and voice input if relevant)
## Action Ideas (exactly 3 numbered, specific and testable)
LENGTH RULE: The whole pulse, including headings, bullets and quotes, must be 200 words or fewer. Aim for 170 to 200 words. Never exceed 200. Keep quotes short and use at most 3 quotes.
Use ONLY this JSON. No new facts or quotes.
{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}

assignments.value:
SOURCE 1 (https://help.openai.com/en/articles/7232895-how-do-i-request-a-refund-for-my-chatgpt-subscription): Payments are generally non-refundable, but refunds may be approved for a verified OpenAI billing error, a validated unauthorized charge, or a documented service or access failure; For an unused individual subscription, a discretionary refund may be possible if the request is made within seven days of the charge and meets eligibility conditions such as no substantial use and no active payment dispute; Cancelling a subscription only stops future renewals and does not by itself make a refund available; Refunds for web and Google Play subscriptions are requested through the Help Center chat while logged in to the account that was charged, and the chat shows an eligibility summary first; Subscriptions bought through Apple must be cancelled or refunded through Apple; An approved web refund is processed within 5 to 7 business days (up to 10 for Google Play), and how soon the money reaches a bank or card also depends on the bank

SOURCE 2 (https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001043-how-do-i-avoid-being-charged-twice-if-i-subscribe-to-chatgpt-on-ios-android-and-the-web): A ChatGPT subscription is managed by the platform where it was bought (Apple App Store, Google Play or chatgpt.com), so starting a new subscription on one platform before cancelling the old one on another can result in several active subscriptions and charges; Users can check for existing subscriptions on each platform: iPhone Settings, then their name, then Subscriptions; Google Play Menu, then Subscriptions; and chatgpt.com Settings, then the Account section; A subscription should be cancelled on the same platform where it was started, and uninstalling the app does not cancel an Apple or Google Play subscription; If an Apple renewal fails, the subscription is not automatically cancelled and Apple may keep trying to recover it, so updating the Apple payment method later can trigger a renewal that duplicates a subscription started elsewhere; A verified duplicate billing error can be reviewed for correction, but holding two separately purchased subscriptions does not by itself qualify for a refund; For refunds, Apple subscriptions go through Apple, Google Play subscriptions go through OpenAI Support while signed in to the charged account, and chatgpt.com subscriptions, or cases where the platform is unclear, go through support
